1b0bb60978ec8f54ef6afdf505708cc992b49eb9.text: The learned rule passes its design-panel checks and gains 50 hits.
But it has one exit in each of two fresh test panels.

49d262e849686a023d597958e85fb089d7f76120.text: What matters here is the difference between a proof covering the allowed
orders and a rule that happened to pass many simulated draws.
More testing alone doesn't turn the second into the first.

d0fc76cae4bbc563679e7ec0e56147eb2efa37cd.text: The retention guarantee still leaves a social-impact question.
Protecting people who already have a place can leave everyone else out.

c78614f6388d93536e47124b2e7ad2cc15c0ffe7.text: Our structural Chile rule has no new entrants on the reported
paired test lotteries. It keeps baseline recipients placed,
but doesn't expand access for those who were unplaced under the baseline.

81b6981160ae391199a6f581ccd5f8f24936a3c9.text: So the next objective must count both groups:
the people we protect and the people still waiting for an opportunity.

af264cc3ef21acad16b761cfcc6463cbcbfa3239.text: For a school district, that would mean reporting two columns at minimum.
Of those who would have received a seat under the old policy,
Of those who would have gone without, how many now have a seat?

dfd0b4ce566f17c86a3005c0202723b172e0058f.text: A rule can score perfectly in the first column while the second stays at zero.

80ab50532972c2e6b112b150d5a2e72b8dc57a4e.text: How people would act on our recommendations is an open question.
They may ignore advice or add choices. Before deployment,
they should be able to correct mistakes and seek human review or appeal.

03009ef423e5dc78b7c16ad8e5b4f3c96c612551.text: Those are proposed safeguards, not interventions we've tested.

6b116686ca35009ef9fa5629b58a13a488fc849e.text: And keeping a seat may mean a worse school.
Historical enrollment and modeled ranks aren't complete welfare measures.

fec0da9a3b4569219f38c14e572844ce0585564b.text: but they cannot create affordable apartments or school capacity.

1a470a26fd2fbbcaed0c0cd0cd9bdc0530ec47bc.text: Even the structural rule's coverage gain is a net figure.
In 115 applicant records the historical school appears for the first time.
In 87 it disappears. None of those losses violates seat retention.

d962245e20c607f1ea395fd6ccde8e4bc414bfca.text: The mathematical promise protects placement status;
it does not protect every useful option or every pupil's preference satisfaction.

322d17fe5b5a30e6f23093218fdacf58d04f113c.text: In a 2021 Chilean field experiment by Agte and colleagues,
families were randomly assigned different versions of a school map.
The basic version showed the schools.

a92fd985437015bb8706e828c913bc26f13c96d8.text: Another version gave counts by price and quality and highlighted
inexpensive schools with medium or high official quality ratings.

b94db7e954984ee2e5aab3897850edf7aaaabfea.text: Compared with the basic map, the highlighted version
raised application submission by three percentage points.
It raised the share ranking a qualifying school second by 5.4 points.

d4fef39fd346f8ebf38f16fa0f101ffc3dc2762c.text: But the estimate for receiving any assignment was only 0.2 points,
with an approximate interval from minus two to plus 2.4 points.
That leaves both gains and losses plausible.

2ed666611d8c4403578178aaead697dea243ee1f.text: The outcomes use different samples. A qualifying second choice met the criteria.
We don't know whether that particular school appeared on that family's map.
The trial establishes that families can respond to information.

21a307a30fb4fea62f557dc30920691952e62b8c.text: It doesn't tell us what would happen if everyone received our shortlists.

655cd1fd30851416d6340612e539eb04f7f2c0e4.text: Here is a reason to care about that last distinction.
Take a market with three pupils and three seats.
The old rule shows the first two pupils school X, and the third pupil school Y.
The new rule points everyone to Y.

5a86440779f2d1a3298ee5507aa09ea5df0a194a.text: At Y, the second pupil has top priority, followed by the first and then the third.

b775aad238e10025436344a826f0c12ec0d49cc5.text: Imagine that each pupil independently has
a one-in-four chance of receiving the new rule.
For the first pupil, switching hurts only when the second pupil also switches.

b81c3a77a2dbf3b36912cdb8091f40700e2264a8.text: For the second pupil, switching helps when the first pupil stays
with X and takes that seat. The third pupil sees Y either way.
That gives individual effects of minus one quarter, plus three quarters, and zero.

88c50ab0bee2ce8ed7b90a93a0fe3535600e81d2.text: Their average is positive, one sixth.

64455739603c38b5c075d85de70f2e7cf574d4b6.text: Now switch everyone. Under the old rule, X and Y each filled a seat.
Under the new rule, everyone competes at Y. Only one seat fills.

c2ba7cdf73ad51766265374fc096d2b1203ff757.text: A positive direct effect in a small trial coexists
with a drop from two placements to one at full rollout.

2a5b9234b5b195a1d52e31ce3d51d3a41a76abc1.text: A field test of the whole policy should therefore track everyone sharing
those seats, including families who never changed their own list.

74a5780f78987c979662b7331a5438040a3ebc49.text: A shortlist reaches beyond the person receiving it.
It changes who competes for the available places.

3adbc5422ee9a21ef74258449008d04d43685a19.text: Our experiments make that interaction visible. Our theory asks what it
takes to improve recommendations while protecting existing recipients.

fc9c04ec81b72a18aace330ae9ef23eedf1ccc91.text: The harder design question is how to open opportunities for people without
a place while keeping those who already have one matched somewhere. Thank you.
